name: Frontend UI
description: React extraction workbench (upload sidebar, result tabs, history, evaluation views, hooks and styling) for reviewing document extractions

name: API Layer
description: FastAPI application entry point and router group exposing extraction, batch job, evaluation and stats endpoints under /api

name: Agent Pipeline
description: Multi-agent extraction pipeline (RapidOCR orchestration plus Router, per-type Extractors, Validator, Judge) with durable Temporal workflow and activities

name: Platform Services
description: Supporting backend services for LLM gateway access, local OCR, field catalog, knowledge-base retrieval, job storage, settings, tracing and KB maintenance CLIs

name: Security Guards
description: Defense-in-depth guardrails for prompt-injection sanitization, upload validation, PII redaction, rate limiting, timeouts and the security audit log

name: Data and Knowledge Base
description: Pydantic contracts, SQLite job persistence, field catalogs, few-shot examples, ground-truth fixtures and retrieval indexes driving extraction

name: Evaluation and Tests
description: Pytest suites covering pipeline, guards, catalog, retrieval and client behavior plus the mock/live evaluation harness scoring extractions

name: Project Configuration
description: Runtime, build, lint and CI configuration together with the one-command setup script for the API and web app

name: Documentation
description: Architecture guides, ADRs, pipeline and guardrail references, evaluation reports and agent skill manuals for the extraction system
